tex_content.html:
Lemma
[piecewise curves have length at least distance] 1. ch3:3.1↗ def:dc-ch3-3-1

If $c:[a,b]\to M$ is piecewise differentiable and the ambient metric is the Riemannian distance, then \[ d(c(a),c(b))\leq \ell (c|_{[a,b]}). \] The estimate is applied on each $C^1$ piece and combined across the vertices using the triangle inequality and additivity of path length.
